skill.summary: Bang.AI AI招聘平台操作。用于：(1) 查看招聘Agent列表和状态 (2) 查看候选人列表和详情 (3) 筛选候选人 (4) 通过/拒绝候选人 (5) 创建新的招聘Agent。触发词：Bang.AI、AI招聘、AI面试、候选人管理、招聘Agent。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of bangai-recruit skill.

- Enables viewing and managing recruitment Agents and candidate lists on Bang.AI AI招聘平台.
- Supports candidate filtering, viewing video resumes, and reviewing (approve/reject) candidates.
- Allows creation of new AI recruitment Agents with automatic candidate search and engagement.
- Accessible to logged-in users via: https://bangai.hina.com/agent?tab=my-interviews
